lines: South Asian Network For The Arts (SANA)
Khoj International Artists’ Association invites applications for a full-time Programme Fellow to work with the Khoj team for a period of 6 – 9 months, beginning in November 2025.
Able to deliver on assigned deadlines and adapt to a fast-paced environment and working within a small, multi-tasking team.
An understanding of and interest in conceptually-driven, socially-engaged, public art projects and South Asian contemporary art
⁠Ability to liaison and work with a variety of stakeholders.
Proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Ability to work flexible hours-including evenings and occasional weekends
Strong project coordination, organisational and administrative skills.
Any previous work experience in art practice, art history, museum studies or related fields would be a plus.
⁠Knowledge of the Adobe software suite is preferred.
Deadline for all applications is 22nd October, 2025
For any queries, please write to us at applications@khojstudios.org with the subject line “Khoj Fellowship Programme 2025”.
